description:
Add a batch/PCLMUL-aware FieldMatrix multiplication path for GF(2^m), avoiding scalar per-element multiplication in the inner matrix-multiply loops.

## Background

`64c88ae4` shows GF(2^m) matrix multiplication runs at roughly tens of Mops/s and has no reference-side comparison populated yet, but the intended project target is to exceed fflas-ffpack by using direct carry-less multiplication. The existing Tier C tasks add element/batch kernels; this task wires those gains into matrix multiplication so FieldMatrix workloads see them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] FieldMatrix multiplication over GF(2^m) uses a batched or tiled PCLMUL-aware path for m in the benchmarked set {8, 16, 32} where the Tier-C kernels are available, with scalar fallback preserved.
- [hard] Correctness is covered against the scalar path for multiple matrix shapes, including rectangular shapes from `64c88ae4` and boundary sizes around the selected tile/crossover.
- [hard] Benchmarks compare pre/post GF(2^m) fgemm throughput and record whether the change is compute-bound or memory-bound.
- [hard] `cargo-ci` and `code-review` gates pass.
- [aspirational] GF(2^m) fgemm throughput improves by at least 2x over the `64c88ae4` published gf2-side baseline for one of m in {8, 16, 32}.
title: Wire GF(2^m) batch kernels into FieldMatrix multiply
